label: Meta Ads (CSV export)
description: Ad spend, results, cost per result and cost per click from a CSV exported from Ads Manager. No API access needed: drop the export in exports/ and refresh.

metrics.name: Ad spend
metrics.definition: Amount spent per day across the exported campaigns, in the account currency.

metrics.name: Ad results
metrics.definition: Results per day as Ads Manager counts them for the campaign objective.

metrics.name: Cost per result
metrics.definition: Ad spend divided by results for the day, blended across campaigns.

metrics.name: Cost per click
metrics.definition: Ad spend divided by link clicks for the day.
